q: The live and neutral wires are insulated in copper and housed together in a PVC sheathed cable.
e: False. The right claim is this: The live and neutral wires are insulated in vulcanised rubber and housed together in either a circular PVC sheathed cable or a circular braided rubber-insulated cable. Neutral is held near zero by the supply company and completes the loop. The printed line wrongly says the live and neutral wires are insulated in copper and housed together in a PVC sheathed cable.
